integrity: Complete analytic proof and reproducible exact arithmetic; eight independent small-dimensional convex-program tests supplement but do not establish the theorem for all parameters.
limitations: Only standard Euclidean nontrivial hypersimplices with n >= 4 and 2 <= k <= n-2; historical priority requires wider human literature assessment; numerical tests are finite.
title: Exact Euclidean facial distance of hypersimplices and a rank-driven minimizing-face transition
